verdict.rationale: Unstructured publishes a structured API reference covering transform, workflow, job, and source-connector endpoints. Its quickstarts ship runnable Python and cURL sample scripts, and the Transform UI offers 'Get Code' to produce integration code. However, nothing shows an interactive try-it console in the reference, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer/playground, a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
